MERALCO POWER SITUATION UPDATE

Bumaba na sa 166,000 customers ng Meralco ang nawalan ng kuryente as of 1 p.m. ngayong Lunes, Nov. 10 dahil sa Super Bagyong #UwanPH. Mula ito sa naiulat na 400,000 na apektadong customers na naiulat kagabi.

Kabilang dito ang mga customer sa Cavite, Bulacan, at Rizal; pati na rin ang ilang bahagi ng Metro Manila, Laguna, Quezon, at Batangas.

“We appeal for our customers’ patience and understanding as we continue working tirelessly on service restoration. We also enjoin the public to continue observing electrical safety precautions, especially in those areas that experienced flooding,” ayon kay Meralco Vice President and Head of Corporate Communications Joe Zaldarriaga.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 13 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 10 November 2025(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Nueva Ecija, Rizal, Metro Manila and Bulacan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Batangas, Bataan, Tarlac(Camiling, San Clemente, Mayantoc, San Jose, Santa Ignacia, Moncada, Paniqui, Capas, Bamban), Zambales(Botolan, Subic, Castillejos, San Marcelino, San Antonio, San Narciso, San Felipe, Cabangan, Iba, Palauig, Olongapo), Quezon(San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, Tayabas, Lucena, Pagbilao, Sariaya, Tiaong, Candelaria, San Antonio, Dolores, Lucban), Cavite(Mendez, Silang, Amadeo, Indang, Alfonso, Magallanes, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Maragondon, Ternate, Tagaytay), Laguna(San Pablo, Alaminos, Nagcarlan, Majayjay, Liliw, Rizal) and Pampanga(Angeles, Mabalacat, Floridablanca, Lubao, Porac) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
